title: Textual DSL, Op-Log And Stateful VCS Mechanism
description: Wave 0 of the "library / dsl / op / ui" split refactor. Add the generic textual mechanism to the vcs crate and framework plugin layer per the approved plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/all-technologies-should-be-groovy-wozniak.md: DocumentDsl + OpText traits, TextSpan/TextError, the op-log text grammar (print/parse document text), a stateful (non-full-replay) DocumentVcsStore with a live `current` projection, FolderTextStorage replacing FileJsonStorage, and framework/plugin plumbing (AppBuilder::example(dsl), PluginApp text load/read, runOp command, HistoryView.recent_ops). This is the shared-file mechanism phase; all later per-technology waves build on it.
summary:
Implemented Wave 0 (the shared mechanism phase) of the library/dsl/op/ui split refactor, scoped to what is safely additive without any technology having migrated yet:

- New `🔖Text` region: `TextSpan`, `TextError` (span-carrying parse/print errors), `DocumentDsl` trait (per-tech document text), `OpText` trait (per-tech single-line op text), and a defaulted `Operation::validate` hook so a corrupt op-log line fails to load with a line number instead of panicking inside `apply`.
- New `🔖TextFormat` region: the op-log grammar (`@doc`/`@edit`/`@change`/`@checkpoint`/`@alternative`/`@active` structural lines, two-space-indented op lines) with `print_document_text`/`print_edit_lines`/`parse_document_text`. Backwards ops and per-operation metadata are recomputed on load, never serialized. Load semantics mirror the existing JSON `load_document` behavior (every edit in the log is treated as applied, in file order).
- Made `DocumentVcsStore` stateful: replaced the old `AmendCache` (which only sped up same-gesture amends) with a live `current: P` field maintained incrementally on every mutating command, plus a `tail_undo_cache` giving O(1) undo of the most recent edit. Cold paths (checkout/switch-alternative/mid-history-undo/set_state) still do a full raw-fold recompute via a new `fold_current` helper. `projection()`/`projection_with_conflicts()` are now O(1) reads instead of full replays.
- Added `test_support::{assert_dsl_round_trip, assert_op_line_round_trip, assert_document_text_round_trip, assert_live_equals_replay}` — the differential/round-trip helpers every technology's own tests will call once it adopts the new traits.
- Added `FolderTextStorage` (new, additive) alongside the existing `FileJsonStorage`/`FolderSqliteStorage` — nothing wires to it automatically yet.
- Extended the crate's own `🧪Tests` with `DocumentDsl`/`OpText` impls on the existing `DemoProjection`/`DemoOperation` test fixtures, plus a new differential stress test (`stateful_current_matches_full_replay_across_interleaved_commands`) exercising multi-op edits, amend gestures, undo/redo, and checkpoints against the full-replay oracle.

Deliberately deferred to the Wave 6 "lock" step (not done now, and why): `framework/plugin`'s `DocumentApp`/`PluginApp` trait changes (`document_dsl` field rename, `document_text`/`load_document_text`, `runOp` command) — `PluginApp` is implemented via a single blanket `impl<A: DocumentApp> PluginApp for VcsDocumentApp<A>`, so real per-tech bodies for these can only exist once `Projection: DocumentDsl` / `Operation: OpText` bounds are added to `DocumentApp` for ALL technologies simultaneously; doing that now would break all ~33 existing plugin crates. Root `script.ts` policy/verify additions were also deferred since enforcing them now (no fixtures have migrated) would break the shared `verify` gate for every other concurrent session in this tree. `FileJsonStorage` deletion and `BackboneMessage` reshape were deferred for the same reason (framework/sync and existing storage consumers still depend on them).

Verification: `cargo test -p vcs --lib` — 49/49 passed (isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR used since another concurrent session held the shared build-directory lock). `cargo check -p vcs --target wasm32-unknown-unknown` — succeeds, zero new warnings (the one pre-existing lint warning at line 654 predates this change). Confirmed via `git diff --stat` that this ticket's only touched file is vcs/rs/lib.rs; the many other framework/* modifications visible in `git status` belong to other concurrent sessions and were left untouched.

Next steps for a future ticket: Wave 1 pilots (draw, note) adopting `DocumentDsl`/`OpText` for real, which will surface whether the grammar/traits need adjustment before fanning out to the remaining ~30 technologies.
